Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Class Companion

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.Actor
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Creature
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Companion
public class Companion extends Creature
Doc, a black-and-gold tiger cub who joins the player after they rub the Atrium's tiger statue. Doc follows the player between floors and attacks nearby monsters. Doc grows stronger as the player levels up. Monsters may attack Doc; a knocked-out Doc retreats to the Atrium to rest and rejoins the next time the player is there.
